capabilities: Review selections or full notes with built-in agent roles (facts, wording, expansion, connection, restructure)
Polish selected text and apply the rewritten version back into the editor
Continue discussions about review results in a follow-up chat view
Configure custom agents, tools, API settings, and context menu buttons
Search the web via Tavily and get the current date for fact-checking
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition review tool; it runs LLM agent reviews that critique and rewrite note text.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true) and intended for manual installation by copying files into .obsidian/plugins/; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get structured AI feedback on a note's facts, wording, or structure, or to rewrite text in place.

requires.name: Tavily API key (falls back to keyless mode)

summary: Multi-agent AI review plugin that fact-checks, critiques, and polishes notes or selections using configurable LLM agent roles.
